review_candidates.description: Position Description At CGI, we design resilient technology foundations that enable complex programmes to deliver securely, efficiently and with confidence. As a Senior Infrastructure Architect, you’ll shape and assure infrastructure solutions for large-scale bids, deals and projects, influencing critical technology decisions from strategy through to delivery. You’ll take ownership of infrastructure architecture, challenge designs and find creative ways to balance business needs, risk, compliance and technical quality. Working across Solution Architecture, engineering, security, data and delivery teams, you’ll be supported by a collaborative community of experts while having the scope to lead partners and suppliers, influence the Technical Design Authority and ensure technology investments deliver sustainable value for our clients. CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK ‘Best Employer’ by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you’ll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We’ll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go. Due to the secure nature of the programme, you will need to hold UK Security Clearance or be eligible to go through this clearance. This is a hybrid position. Your future duties and responsibilities In this role, you will take ownership of infrastructure architecture across large-scale bids, deals and projects, bridging the gap between Solution Architects, development teams, business stakeholders and project management. You’ll provide strategic guidance and technical leadership, defining and validating infrastructure solutions that balance requirements, value, risk and long-term architectural direction. You’ll work closely with the Technical Design Authority (TDA), solution partners and subcontractors to provide assurance that designs are fit for purpose and meet statutory, regulatory, contractual and non-functional requirements. You’ll have the opportunity to challenge established thinking and shape effective solutions, while drawing on expertise across CGI’s wider architecture community to ensure consistent best practice across infrastructure, application, security and data domains. Lead & Architect: Define and validate infrastructure architectures for complex bids, deals and delivery programmes. Assure & Govern: Provide architectural assurance to the TDA and programme leadership, ensuring solutions are fit for purpose. Validate & Protect: Ensure infrastructure designs fulfil non-functional requirements and applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual obligations. Align & Optimise: Maintain alignment with relevant Solution, Reference and Target architectures while maximising value from technology investment. Guide & Influence: Provide strategic infrastructure guidance to technical, business and programme stakeholders. Manage & Mitigate: Identify architectural risks and provide guidance to manage significant technical and delivery exposure. Partner & Deliver: Lead infrastructure solution definition with solution partners and subcontractors and document designs ready for delivery. Collaborate & Improve: Work across architecture disciplines to strengthen consistency and promote reusable best practices. Connect & Support: Bring architecture, development, business and project teams together to enable informed technology decisions and successful delivery. Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role You’ll bring substantial Infrastructure Architecture experience within complex enterprise environments, with the technical breadth and leadership skills to define, challenge and assure solutions across large-scale programmes or bids. You’ll combine sound architectural judgement with strong stakeholder management, taking ownership of decisions while collaborating effectively with architecture, engineering, business, supplier and delivery teams. Extensive experience in Infrastructure Architecture, ideally across complex enterprise programmes, major projects or large-scale bids. Proven experience defining and documenting infrastructure solutions through architecture and detailed delivery design activities. Strong architecture governance and assurance capability, including working with Technical Design Authorities or equivalent governance forums. Strong understanding of non-functional requirements, with experience assuring their fulfilment within technology solutions. Good understanding of statutory, regulatory and contractual compliance as it relates to infrastructure architecture and solution delivery. Proven ability to assess and manage architectural and technical risk within complex environments. Experience working with Solution, Reference and Target architectures and applying architectural standards consistently. Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across technical, business and programme audiences. Experience leading solution partners, suppliers or subcontractors through infrastructure design and delivery. Broad understanding of adjacent architecture domains, including application, security and data architecture. Strong technical leadership and problem-solving skills, with the ability to challenge constructively and develop pragmatic solutions. Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because… You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction. Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise. You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons. That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals. Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

review_candidates.description: Hiring Salary Range : $ 215 400,00 - 261 660,00 This range represents the hiring range. Salaries are determined individually depending on skills and experience. You will also be eligible to an annual bonus, employee share investment program (ESIP), Pension, Benefits, Railroad Retirement Benefits (RRB) and other perks. At CN , everyday brings new and exciting challenges . Y ou can expect a n interesting environment where you’re part of making sure our business is running opti mally and safely ― helping keep the economy on track . W e provide the kind of paid training and opportunit ies that long-term careers are built on and we recognize hard workers who strive to make a difference. You will be able to thrive in our close-knit, safe ty-focused culture working together as ONE TEAM . The careers we offer are meaningful because the work we do matters. Join us! Job Summary The General Manager (GM) is responsible for planning, developing, and overseeing carload operations across a designated territory. This role ensures the safety of operations, network fluidity, volume growth, and customer satisfaction while managing costs and mitigating risks. The GM leads multi-disciplinary teams and drives strategic initiatives aligned with CN’s operational and cultural priorities. Main Responsibilities Organic Growth - Mobilize and manage multi-disciplinary teams including crew management, rail traffic control, and transportation control systems to ensure network fluidity and cross-functional collaboration. - Integrate new T&E employees in partnership with CN Campus to optimize resource utilization. - Deepen understanding of customer base and service requirements to develop full supply chain offerings that support year-over-year volume and pricing growth. Cost Efficiencies Improve T&E employee retention through proactive engagement and workforce planning. - Mitigate collective agreement violations to minimize operational costs and labor risks. Inorganic Growth Efficiently integrate and manage resources (assets and staff) resulting from mergers and acquisitions. - Align operational practices and workforce culture post-integration to ensure continuity and performance. Risk Management - Embed a safety-first mindset across all levels of the function, from unionized employees to direct reports. - Develop and manage safety plans based on operational data and trends. - Respond to emergencies and service disruptions with strategic coordination and leadership. Team Development Evaluate and coach senior and mid-level managers to build leadership capacity. - Manage labor productivity, manpower planning, and budget adherence. - Handle grievances and disciplinary decisions in alignment with collective agreements. - Foster succession planning and talent development across the territory. Working Conditions This role operates in a 24/7 environment with significant travel (60–80%) across the assigned territory. It requires outdoor work and availability to respond to emergencies. The incumbent must be able to work under pressure and meet tight deadline Requirements: Experience Minimum 10 years of railway management experience, including oversight of day-to-day operations across multiple terminals or territories. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive safety, service, and financial performance. Experience in labor relations, service design, and rail traffic control. Education Post-secondary education in Transportation, Logistics, Management, or related field. Conductor or Locomotive Engineer qualification preferred. Post-graduate education and bilingualism (English/French) are assets. Competencies Safety focus, accountability, leadership, stakeholder engagement, and problem-solving. Ability to manage complex operations and lead through change. Technical Skills Comprehensive knowledge of railway operations, including CROR and CN systems (LMS, CATS, SRS, RTBI). Strong understanding of operational and financial metrics. Ability to leverage analytics and reporting tools to drive performance. About CN CN is a premium railroad that sustainably generates value for our customers, shareholders, employees, and stakeholders with an unwavering commitment to safety and service. Essential to the economy, to the customers, and to the communities it serves, CN safely transports more than 300 million tons of natural resources, manufactured products, and finished goods throughout North America every year. CN's network connects Canada's Eastern and Western coasts with the U.S. South through a 20,000-mile rail network. CN and its affiliates have been contributing to community prosperity and sustainable trade since 1919. CN powers the North American economy and is committed to programs supporting social responsibility and environmental stewardship. At CN, we are dedicated to building North America's safest , most inclusive and sustainable railroad, which includes reflecting the communities in which we operate.
